answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy gives each newcomer a pearl probation tier and locks a bond for 24 epochs. Random auditors reproduce three distinct tasks; a failed audit burns 20 percent of the bond. An umber sponsor quota allows only two new identities per epoch, while a dune registry compares signed output fingerprints and quarantines correlated accounts. Full rewards unlock after seven clean rounds, making fake identities costly and slow; task hashes keep the decision trail independently auditable.
